summary.text: Samantha Sencer-Mura is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 63A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former teacher and nonprofit executive director, she faces Republican Kyle Bragg in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Samantha Sencer-Mura lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
She earned a B.A. in critical theory and social justice from Occidental College in 2010 and a master's in school leadership from Harvard University in 2017.

Her career experience includes work as a teacher at Citizen Schools, a teaching artist at Streetside Stories, an extended day coordinator at Safe Passages, a full service community schools director at United for Success Academy, and executive director of 826 MSP.
Sencer-Mura defeated Kyle Bragg in the 2022 general election for District 63A and took office on January 3, 2023, and she won re-election in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Education Finance, Children and Families Finance and Policy, and House Transportation Finance and Policy committees.
